description:
Where a case stands.

The happy path is `received -> preparing -> running -> validating -> ready -> delivering -> completed`, with `running <-> awaiting_answer` repeating as often as the agent needs answers.

oneOf.description: Accepted and durable; nothing has been done with it yet.
Importing attachments, resolving the repository, selecting a backend.
A question is outstanding; no job holds the case.
A candidate output is being validated.
A valid output exists and delivery has not been attempted.
Delivery is in progress, including between scheduled retries.
The destination accepted the refined prompt.
The case stopped without delivering. Any output produced is preserved, so a user may retry delivery from here.

title: CaseState
